 Pandey
 Oral Order
2 08-09-2025
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners as well as the learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with Bhagalpur Mahila P.S. Case No. 14 of 2024, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 341, 504, 506, 34 of the IPC and 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. The prosecution case, in brief, is that the informant got married with Md. Sikandar Ali on 04.11.2022 as per Muslim rituals.
Her father gave 2 lakhs cash, gold and silver ornaments as gifts.
After marriage, the accused persons demanded an additional 2 lakhs and a motorcycle as dowry and threatened her to kill, if she didn't fulfill the demand of dowry.

She then Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.59144 of 2025(2) dt.08-09-2025 went to her parental home.
On 25.01.2024, on being called by Md. Riyaz, she returned to her matrimonial home with her son, mother and others, where she was again tortured for dowry.
On 04.03.2024, the accused persons confined her and assaulted her with cholni, flower pot and fists with intent to kill, but she was rescued by the neighbours.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are innocent and have Sakila Bano vs The State Of Bihar on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69834517/
1 falsely been implicated in this case.

entities.text: Sakila Bano vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioners are old and infirm mother-in-law and father-in-law of the informant, and they have been made accused merely because they are mother and father of main accused Md. Sikandar Ali.
They have no concern with day-to-day affairs of the couple.

5. On the other hand, the learned APP for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the victim has suffered simple injuries on her person, which shows that atrocities were inflicted on her, to which the learned counsel for the petitioner replied that the injury may be assigned to the husband of the informant and not to the petitioners, who are old and infirm.

6. Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioners, in the event of their arrest or Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.59144 of 2025(2) dt.08-09-2025 surrender within four weeks before the learned court below, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/-
(Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M.-IX, Bhagalpur in connection with Bhagalpur (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 14 of 2024, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) kundan/-
